purpose: Decision-readiness register. A decision should not be made until the 'Information needed' column is answered from a trusted source.

questions.question: What product did the owner intend behind each supplied short link?
questions.information_needed: The intended ASIN, official listing URL, confirmation date, and source for each of the five links.
questions.what_we_have: Observed redirect targets for 4 of 5 links (2026-11-20), verified against official listing pages.
questions.what_we_dont_have: Any public or first-party statement of intent. The product-intent confirmation fields are blank by design.
questions.how_to_discover: Owner resolves each link from a normal browser session and records the intended ASIN + confirmation date. Do not infer intent from the redirect.

questions.question: Are the five supplied short links compliant Associates Special Links?
questions.information_needed: Confirmation that each link uses the tagged Special Link format and passes the enrolled-workflow test (destination + tracking report).
questions.what_we_have: The links resolve to real Amazon listings for 4 of 5 (P-04 redirect unverified). Exact compliance status is unresolved (FLG-003).
questions.what_we_dont_have: Associate ID/tag presence in the redirect chain and tracking-report confirmation for any link.
questions.how_to_discover: Test one link per product through the enrolled Associates workflow (SG-07) and record the destination and tracking report.

questions.question: Which Associate ID / tag is attached to these links?
questions.information_needed: The Associate ID (XXXXX-## format) in each link's parameters, if any.
questions.what_we_have: The submitted link.amazon URLs as given.
questions.what_we_dont_have: Inspection of the final redirected URL parameters and access to the Associates dashboard.
questions.how_to_discover: Resolve the links with redirect inspection (browser or curl -I) and read the Associates dashboard link inventory.

questions.question: What commission rates apply to these product categories?
questions.information_needed: Current Standard Commission Income for the relevant categories.
questions.what_we_have: The official Commission Income Statement location (S2).
questions.what_we_dont_have: The current rate table values for kitchen small appliances and kitchen gadgets, read from the official statement.
questions.how_to_discover: Read the Commission Income Statement on the official Program Policies page (S2) and record the rate + date read.

questions.question: What questions are real buyers typing, and in what volume?
questions.information_needed: Measured query data (queries, impressions, clicks) for the site.
questions.what_we_have: Editorial hypotheses (working titles) for four buyer questions - explicitly not claims about popularity or volume.
questions.what_we_dont_have: Any measurement. The site has no live analytics history.
questions.how_to_discover: Deploy the click counter + Search Console (SG-05, SG-08), then review queries on a cadence and pick topics from the data.

questions.question: What publishing cadence is realistic for this project?
questions.information_needed: Owner's capacity commitment (hours/week) and quality bar.
questions.what_we_have: A suggested biweekly cadence in SG-02.
questions.how_to_discover: Owner decision in the Suggestions review; no external source exists.

questions.question: Where will analytics event data be hosted, stored, and how long retained?
questions.information_needed: A hosting decision plus a privacy notice covering purpose, storage, retention, and third parties.
questions.what_we_have: A self-hosted endpoint (server/analytics_server.py) that stores no IP addresses and no cookies.
questions.what_we_dont_have: A hosting provider/decision and a published privacy notice.
questions.how_to_discover: Owner decision; then publish a privacy notice before any real data flows (SG-12).

questions.question: May the site use official Amazon product imagery?
questions.information_needed: Confirmation against the Associates IP License and Program Policies.
questions.what_we_have: The Operating Agreement describes Program Content (images, text, link formats) made available by Amazon (S1).
questions.what_we_dont_have: A compliance ruling on using listing-page imagery pulled outside the provided Program Content.
questions.how_to_discover: Compliance review of the IP License section in the Program Policies (S2) and, if needed, Associates support.

questions.question: Which additional niches beyond air fryers and meat thermometers should be explored?
questions.information_needed: Measured demand signals (queries, competitor coverage, commission viability).
questions.what_we_have: Five verified products across two categories.
questions.what_we_dont_have: Any demand measurement for other niches.
questions.how_to_discover: Only after Q-05 is answered with real data - do not pick niches from instinct.

questions.question: What is the P-04 redirect target (link.amazon/B0c8moW59)?
questions.information_needed: The observed redirect target for P-04.
questions.what_we_have: Candidate ASIN B0DHZTCNR5 verified to exist (ThermoMaven 1-Sec thermometer) - consistent with a prior-session record, but NOT a redirect observation.
questions.what_we_dont_have: A live redirect observation in this session (bot checkpoint blocked it).
questions.how_to_discover: Owner resolves the link from a normal browser session and records the target; then re-run the intake validation.
